scripts.migrate:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile migrate run --build --rm migrate
scripts.prod:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile api up --build -d
scripts.prod:deploy:local: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile migrate run --build --rm migrate && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile api up --build -d
scripts.prod:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile api down
scripts.prod:ps: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile api ps
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile api logs --tail=200 -f backend
scripts.build:backend:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --no-cache backend migrate
scripts.build:frontend: docker buildx build -f frontend/Dockerfile --target export --output type=local,dest=./artifacts/frontend ./frontend
